item.title: Feedback.one: A Refreshing Take on User Feedback Built with Elm and Rust
item.author: hi@cekrem.dev (Christian Ekrem)
item.description:
I recently added a new feedback widget to this site – Feedback.one – and I’m impressed enough with it that I thought it deserved its own post. Beyond being a useful tool, it’s also an excellent example of how functional programming languages like Elm can shine in production environments.
